scripts.clean: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path 'prisma\dev.db') { Remove-Item -Force 'prisma\dev.db' }; if (Test-Path 'prisma\dev.db-journal') { Remove-Item -Force 'prisma\dev.db-journal' }; if (Test-Path 'node_modules') { Remove-Item -Force -Recurse 'node_modules' }; if (Test-Path 'dist') { Remove-Item -Force -Recurse 'dist' }; if (Test-Path 'prisma\migrations') { Remove-Item -Force -Recurse 'prisma\migrations' }; exit 0"
